s.note: Rey's ration of powder that puffs into bread on Jakku
s.how: Mix 450g flour, a teaspoon of bicarb soda and a teaspoon of salt. Stir in 400ml buttermilk to a soft dough. Shape into a round, cut a deep cross on top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it rises and sounds hollow. Tear warm and serve with butter and honey.

s.note: the desert trading post on Jakku
s.how: Slit 16 medjool dates and remove the stones. Fill each with a little goat's cheese and press a walnut half on top. Drizzle with honey and arrange on a board with dried apricots and dried figs, like rations traded for a portion at the outpost.

m.note: Maz Kanata's busy castle on Takodana
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with crushed garlic, rosemary, smoked paprika, olive oil and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart easily. Serve on a big board with warm flatbreads, garlic yoghurt and a tray of roasted vegetables.

w.note: the island where Rey finds Luke
w.how: Mix 450g self-raising flour with 300ml cream and 300ml lemonade until just combined. Pat out on a floured bench, cut into rounds and bake close together at 220C for 15 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with strawberry jam and whipped cream.

d.note: Han and Chewie back on the Falcon, home
d.how: Brew 250ml very strong coffee or 4 espresso shots. Warm 700ml milk with 3 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon, whisking until frothy, without boiling. Divide the coffee between four metal mugs and pour in the hot chocolate milk. Top with whipped cream from 150ml cream and dust with cocoa.
